description: Browse helpful answers to important questions, providing the clarity you need before choosing roofing services for your home confidently today.

assessment.q: How do I know if my roof needs repair or replacement?
assessment.a: Our free roof inspection helps determine whether a repair is enough or if a full replacement is the better long term solution. We evaluate the age of your roof, visible damage, leaks, and overall structural condition before making any recommendation.

insurance.q: Will you help with my insurance claim?
insurance.a: Yes. If your roof has been damaged by hail, wind, or severe weather, we can assist throughout the insurance claims process by documenting the damage and working directly with your insurance adjuster when needed.

warranty.q: Do your roofing services include workmanship and manufacturer warranties?
warranty.a: Absolutely. Our roofing projects include workmanship warranties, and many of the premium materials we install are backed by manufacturer warranties for added protection and long term peace of mind.

presence.q: Do I need to be home during the roofing project?
presence.a: In most cases, no. As long as we have access to the property and have discussed all project details beforehand, our team can complete the work while you continue with your daily routine.

protection.q: How do you protect my property during the installation?
protection.a: We take extra precautions to protect your landscaping, siding, windows, and outdoor areas. Once the project is complete, we perform a thorough cleanup, including magnetic sweeps to collect nails and debris.

weather.q: What happens if bad weather delays my roofing project?
weather.a: Safety always comes first. If severe weather affects the schedule, we'll notify you immediately, secure your roof if necessary, and resume work as soon as conditions allow without compromising quality.

scheduling.q: How soon can you schedule my roofing project?
scheduling.a: Scheduling depends on the scope of the project and current availability. After your inspection and estimate, we'll provide the earliest available start date and keep you informed throughout the entire process.

similar.q: Can you complete a project similar to one I've seen here?
similar.a: Absolutely. Every roofing project is customized to match your property's structure, architectural style, budget, and long term performance goals. If you see a project you like, we can create a solution tailored specifically to your home or business.

duration.q: How long do roofing projects typically take to complete?
duration.a: Most residential roofing projects are completed within one to three days, while larger or more complex commercial projects may require additional time depending on the roofing system, weather conditions, and project scope.

occupied.q: Can you work on occupied homes and commercial properties?
occupied.a: Yes. Our crews regularly complete roofing projects while homes and businesses remain occupied. We follow strict safety procedures and work efficiently to minimize disruptions throughout the project.

permits.q: Are permits required for roofing projects?
permits.a: Permit requirements vary depending on your location and the scope of the project. When permits are required, we handle the process and help ensure all work complies with local building codes.

matching.q: Can you match the style and color of my existing roof?
matching.a: Yes. We offer a wide range of roofing materials, colors, and profiles to complement your property's architecture while meeting your durability, performance, and budget requirements.

hidden.q: What happens if unexpected issues are discovered during the project?
hidden.a: If hidden damage or structural issues are found, we'll explain the situation, provide clear recommendations, and discuss all available options before performing any additional work.

start.q: How do I get started with a roofing project?
start.a: Getting started is simple. Contact our team to schedule a roof inspection, and we'll evaluate your property, discuss your goals, and provide a detailed proposal with the best solution for your project.

licensed.q: Are you a licensed and insured roofing contractor in Florida?
licensed.a: Absolutely. We are fully licensed and insured to operate across Florida. We carry comprehensive general liability and workers' compensation insurance, protecting you and your property throughout the entire project.

hurricanes.q: Are your roofs built to withstand Florida hurricanes?
hurricanes.a: Yes. We install advanced roofing systems that meet or exceed the rigorous Florida Building Code, utilizing high quality materials and installation methods designed to provide enhanced protection against Florida's high winds and severe weather conditions.

insurance.q: Do you assist with insurance claims?
insurance.a: Yes. We help you navigate the insurance claim process with thorough roof inspections, accurate documentation, and professional support at every step.

permits.q: Do I need a permit for a new roof in Florida?
permits.a: Yes. Most roof replacements require local permits. Our team handles the entire permitting process from start to finish and schedules all required inspections to ensure your project complies with local building codes.

warranty.q: Do you provide warranties on your work?
warranty.a: Yes. Every project includes our comprehensive workmanship warranty, and most roofing systems also feature extended manufacturer warranties for added long term protection and peace of mind.

replacement.q: How long does a typical roof replacement take?
replacement.a: Most residential roof replacements are completed within 1 to 3 days, depending on the size of your home, roofing material, weather conditions, and permit requirements. We'll provide a detailed timeline before your project begins.

signs.q: How can I tell if my roof needs to be replaced?
signs.a: Common signs include missing or damaged shingles, persistent leaks, sagging areas, or water stains on ceilings. We provide free professional inspections to determine whether a targeted repair or a full replacement is the best option for your home.

assessment.q: How do I know if my roof needs replacement instead of repair?
assessment.a: Our inspection looks at the roof's age, structural condition, leaks, missing materials, and overall performance. If a repair is still a safe and cost effective option, we'll recommend it instead of a replacement.

materials.q: What roofing materials are available for my home?
materials.a: We install asphalt shingles, clay and concrete tile, metal roofing, and flat roofing systems. We'll help you choose the best option based on your home's style, budget, and long term performance.

permits.q: Will you handle permits and code requirements?
permits.a: Yes. We obtain the required permits and complete your project according to current local building codes and inspection requirements.

duration.q: How long does a residential roof replacement take?
duration.a: Most residential roof replacements are completed in one to two days. Larger homes, specialty materials, and weather conditions may extend the schedule.

weather.q: What happens if bad weather arrives during installation?
weather.a: Our crew closely monitors weather conditions and protects your home throughout the project. If needed, installation is safely paused until conditions improve.

property.q: Will my property be protected during the project?
property.a: Yes. We protect landscaping, perform daily cleanup, use magnetic nail sweeps, remove all debris, and complete a final walkthrough before the project is finished.

warranty.q: What warranties are included with a new roof?
warranty.a: Every project includes a written workmanship warranty along with the manufacturer's material warranty, giving you long term protection and peace of mind.

suitable.q: Is metal roofing a good choice for homes in Florida?
suitable.a: Yes. Metal roofing is designed to handle Florida's heat, heavy rain, and severe weather conditions while providing long term durability and protection.

lifespan.q: How long can I expect a properly installed metal roof to last?
lifespan.a: A properly installed metal roofing system can provide decades of performance with minimal maintenance compared to many traditional roofing materials.

efficiency.q: Will installing a metal roof help improve my home's energy efficiency?
efficiency.a: Yes. Metal roofing can help reflect solar heat and improve energy performance when combined with proper insulation and ventilation.

overlay.q: Can a metal roofing system be installed over my existing roof?
overlay.a: It depends on the current roof condition, local requirements, and the selected system. We evaluate your property and recommend the proper installation method.

options.q: What metal roofing styles, finishes, and colors are available?
options.a: We offer different metal profiles, finishes, and colors to match your home's design while providing the durability and performance you expect.

noise.q: Will rain and storms make a metal roof noisy inside my home?
noise.a: With proper underlayment, insulation, and installation methods, metal roofing provides comfortable sound levels during rain and severe weather.

warranty.q: What warranty protection comes with a new metal roof?
warranty.a: Your metal roofing system includes applicable manufacturer coverage along with our written workmanship warranty for installation quality.

seamless.a: Seamless gutters are formed on site to fit your roofline in one continuous piece, so there are far fewer joints to leak or clog.

flashing.q: Why does flashing matter so much?
flashing.a: Flashing seals the joints where the roof meets walls, valleys, and chimneys. Bad flashing is one of the most common causes of leaks.

clogs.q: Can you help with constant gutter clogs?
clogs.a: Yes. We size the gutters correctly, add proper downspouts, and can install guards to keep debris moving through.

foundation.q: Do gutters really protect the foundation?
foundation.a: They do. Moving water away from the house keeps it off the foundation and siding, preventing rot and costly structural damage.

cost.q: How much do new gutters cost?
cost.a: Cost depends on the length of the roofline and the materials. You get a fixed line item quote before any work begins.

warranty.q: Is there a warranty on gutter work?
warranty.a: Yes. Every gutter and flashing job is backed by our written workmanship warranty.

duration.q: How long does a full roof replacement take?
duration.a: Most residential roof replacements are completed within one to two days. The timeline can vary depending on the size of your home, roofing material, permit requirements, weather conditions, and any additional repairs discovered during the replacement process.

presence.q: Do I need to leave the house during a roof replacement?
presence.a: No. Most homeowners can stay at home during the project. Our team works to minimize disruption while maintaining a safe work area, and we recommend keeping pets and children away from active installation zones.

cost.q: What factors affect the cost of a roof replacement?
cost.a: The total investment depends on your roof size, selected materials, existing roof conditions, decking repairs, flashing requirements, and project complexity. We provide a detailed written estimate outlining the complete scope before installation begins.

warranty.q: Is the warranty on materials or workmanship?
warranty.a: A roof replacement includes manufacturer warranty coverage for the roofing materials and our written workmanship warranty for the installation. This provides protection for both the products used and the quality of the work performed.

leaks.q: Will a roof replacement fix my existing leaks?
leaks.a: A complete roof replacement removes the old roofing system and addresses the underlying issues affecting your home's protection. With proper installation, your new system is designed to provide reliable performance and long term weather protection.

rain.q: What happens if it rains during my roof replacement?
rain.a: We monitor weather conditions throughout the project and take the necessary precautions to protect your home. If severe weather creates unsafe conditions, installation is temporarily paused until work can continue safely.

permit.q: Do you handle permits and inspections?
permit.a: Yes. We manage the required permits and coordinate inspections throughout the replacement process. This helps ensure your new roofing system is installed according to local building requirements and project standards.

cost.q: How much does a roof repair cost?
cost.a: It depends on the damage, but most repairs are a small fraction of a replacement. We give one flat written price before any work starts.

temporary.q: Is a repair just a temporary fix?
temporary.a: No. We fix the real cause, not just the symptom, and back every repair with a written workmanship warranty so it lasts.

insurance.q: Will insurance cover my roof repair?
insurance.a: Often yes, when storm damage is the cause. We document everything with photos and can work directly with your adjuster on the claim.

warranty.q: Do repairs come with a warranty?
warranty.a: Yes. Every repair is backed by our written workmanship warranty, and any manufacturer warranty on the materials we install still applies.

emergency.q: Can you handle emergency leaks fast?
emergency.a: Yes. We offer same day tarping to stop active leaks, then return to complete a permanent repair as soon as possible.

matching.q: Will the repair match my existing roof?
matching.a: We match your shingle color and profile as closely as possible, so the repaired area blends in and looks like the rest.

leak.a: Not when installed right. We use a leak proof flashing kit and seal every edge, and we water test the skylight before we leave.

rooms.q: Which rooms work best for a skylight?
rooms.a: Dark hallways, bathrooms without windows, kitchens, and living rooms all benefit from the natural light a skylight brings in.

heat.q: Will a skylight make the room hot?
heat.a: We install energy efficient units with low emissivity glass that let in light while blocking much of the Florida heat.

existing.q: Can you add a skylight to my existing roof?
existing.a: Yes. We plan the opening around your rafters, cut and frame it cleanly, and seal it into the existing roof.

cost.q: How much does a skylight cost?
cost.a: Cost depends on the unit and the roof, but you get a fixed written quote covering the skylight, flashing, and interior finish.

warranty.q: What warranty comes with a skylight?
warranty.a: You get the manufacturer warranty on the unit plus our written workmanship warranty on the leak proof installation.

inspection.q: Do you offer free storm damage inspections?
inspection.a: Yes. After any major storm we provide a free photo documented inspection so you know exactly what damage your roof took.

claim.q: Will you work with my insurance company?
claim.a: We do. We document everything and coordinate directly with your insurer from the first claim through final approval.

emergency.q: Can you tarp my roof right away?
emergency.a: Yes. Our emergency crews secure and tarp damaged roofs fast to stop further water damage while your claim is processed.

deductible.q: What will I pay out of pocket?
deductible.a: Usually just your insurance deductible on covered claims. We give you a clear written scope so there are no surprises.

timeline.a: Emergency work happens immediately. Full repairs begin as soon as your claim is approved and materials are on hand.

denied.q: What if my claim is denied?
denied.a: We help you understand the decision and document the damage thoroughly, which often supports an appeal or a fair repair plan.

systems.q: What commercial roof systems do you install?
systems.a: We install TPO, EPDM, and torch applied modified bitumen, matching the system to your building and budget.

disruption.q: Will the work disrupt my business?
disruption.a: We schedule around your hours and work in sections, keeping noise and access issues to a minimum so you stay open.

ponding.q: Can you fix ponding water on a flat roof?
ponding.a: Yes. We add tapered insulation and correct the drainage so water flows off instead of pooling and wearing the membrane.

maintenance.q: Do you offer maintenance for commercial roofs?
maintenance.a: We do. Scheduled inspections and minor repairs extend the life of the membrane and protect your warranty.

warranty.q: What warranty comes with a commercial roof?
warranty.a: You get the manufacturer membrane warranty plus our written workmanship warranty on the installation.

cost.q: How is a commercial roof priced?
cost.a: By square footage, system, and access. You get a detailed written scope and price with clear terms and no hidden change orders.

frequency.q: How often should my roof be inspected?
frequency.a: We recommend a professional inspection twice a year and after any major storm to catch small issues early.

plan.q: What does a maintenance plan include?
plan.a: Seasonal inspections, gutter cleaning, minor sealant and flashing tune ups, and a written report after every visit.

warranty.a: Yes. Many manufacturer warranties require regular maintenance, and our reports document that your roof is being cared for.

cost.q: How much does a maintenance plan cost?
cost.a: Plans are priced for the year based on roof size and access, with a clear flat price and no surprise per visit billing.

worth.q: Is roof maintenance really worth it?
worth.a: Absolutely. Catching a small leak or lifted shingle early costs far less than a major repair down the road.

repairs.q: Do you handle repairs found during maintenance?
repairs.a: We do, and plan members get priority scheduling so small problems are fixed before they grow.

roof.q: Do you install the roof and the solar panels?
roof.a: Yes. We integrate the panels with your roofing system the right way, so the mounts are sealed and flashed and the roof stays protected.

leaks.a: Not with proper installation. Every mounting point is sealed and flashed, and we reinforce the deck where needed.

new.q: Should I replace my roof before going solar?
new.a: If your roof is aging, yes. Installing panels on a new roof avoids removing them later and protects your investment for decades.

savings.q: How much can solar save me?
savings.a: Savings depend on your usage and layout, but a smart panel layout on a sunny Florida roof can cut energy bills significantly.

output.q: How do you get the best output?
output.a: We assess your roof for sun exposure and design the panel layout to capture the most energy across the day.

warranty.q: Is the roof still under warranty with solar?
warranty.a: Yes. Our workmanship warranty covers the roof work, and the panels carry their own manufacturer warranty.
